_meta.registration: user scope: $CODEX_HOME/config.toml [[hooks.<Event>]] (a hooks.json file in the same layer is also read; Codex warns when both exist). Run with codex exec --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust because untrusted user hooks are skipped silently in exec mode.

fields.cwd: present on SessionStart and PreToolUse (absolute, realpath form /private/tmp/...)
fields.session_id: present on both events; same value across events
fields.hook_process_PWD: equals the session cwd (/tmp/... symlink form, not realpath)

findings: Codex delivers cwd in the payload, so US-007 does not need the $PWD fallback for Codex, but should still use $PWD when cwd is absent.
Each event ran the hook command twice (two processes, identical payload and tool_use_id) in this capture, so dispatch dedupe is needed on Codex too.
